note: Dialogues are scripted files (data/dialog-*.txt) echoed as 'you>' lines; the answers are the model's. Do not tune the system prompt, dialogues or checks. If the memory dialogue never folds, lower --history-budget (for example 300) and say so in the voice-over.
prepare: # owner signs in as labadmin (device code), not on camera
az account show --query name -o none 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { az login --use-device-code }
$me = az ad signed-in-user show --query id -o tsv
az group create -n rg-mglab-ai-11 -l swedencentral -o none

$o = az deployment group create -g rg-mglab-ai-11 -f infra/main.bicep -p infra/main.bicepparam -p developerPrincipalId=$me --query properties.outputs -o json | ConvertFrom-Json; if ($LASTEXITCODE) { throw 'deployment to rg-mglab-ai-11 failed' }
Start-Sleep -Seconds 300   # role assignment propagation (up to 5 minutes)
python -m helpbot chat --script data/dialog-ticket.txt | Out-Null   # dry run

screens.name: deployments
steps: Open Models + endpoints (or Azure portal > the resource > Deployments)
Open the resource's authentication view and show local (key) authentication disabled
mask: tenant name / directory in the top bar
signed-in user name, UPN and avatar in the account menu

teardown: az cognitiveservices account purge -g rg-mglab-ai-11 -n $env:AOAI_NAME -l swedencentral
